name: add_username_history_and_events
query: create table if not exists public.username_changes (id bigint generated by default as identity primary key, user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, old_username text, new_username text not null, changed_at timestamptz not null default now()); create index if not exists username_changes_user_changed_at_idx on public.username_changes (user_id, changed_at desc); alter table public.username_changes enable row level security; drop policy if exists username_changes_select_own on public.username_changes; create policy username_changes_select_own on public.username_changes for select to authenticated using (auth.uid() = user_id); drop policy if exists username_changes_insert_own on public.username_changes; create policy username_changes_insert_own on public.username_changes for insert to authenticated with check (auth.uid() = user_id); create table if not exists public.username_events (id bigint generated by default as identity primary key, user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, event_type text not null check (event_type in ('unavailable', 'suggestion_selected')), created_at timestamptz not null default now()); create index if not exists username_events_created_at_idx on public.username_events (created_at desc); alter table public.username_events enable row level security; drop policy if exists username_events_insert_own on public.username_events; create policy username_events_insert_own on public.username_events for insert to authenticated with check (auth.uid() = user_id);
